channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.6.44
- Replaces the scrolling waveform with a compact radial Voice Halo centered on the complete Templeton swirl. - The two sage rings respond directly to microphone level while preserving a calm, static presentation when Reduce Motion is enabled. - Renames the Listening Display option to Voice Halo so Settings matches the on-screen experience.

# Kiki 0.6.43
- Replaces the scrolling waveform with a compact radial Voice Halo centered on the Templeton swirl. - The two sage rings respond directly to microphone level while preserving a calm, static presentation when Reduce Motion is enabled. - Renames the Listening Display option to Voice Halo so Settings matches the on-screen experience.

# Kiki 0.6.42
- Automatically creates a fully local meeting brief with Summary, Decisions, Action items, and Next steps after transcription. - Keeps the newest live dictation words visible as the Full Transcript display fills. - Adds deterministic coverage for meeting insights, honest empty states, and the rolling transcript behavior. - Preserves speaker labels and timestamps so every extracted decision and task remains traceable to the transcript.

# Kiki 0.6.41
- Centers Voice Studio workflow badges and their labels as one consistent unit. - Centers the Models hardware icon and active-state label without one-off offsets. - Adds deterministic layout checks for both alignment systems. - Verifies the corrected layouts at minimum, default, and large Workbench sizes.

# Kiki 0.6.40
- Adds a responsive, state-aware native voice instrument for dictation. - Replaces generic Home workflow symbols with original Kiki hardware glyphs. - Adds layered audio-file drop artwork and a custom local processing indicator. - Preserves full shortcut guidance at compact window widths and honors Reduce Motion. - Adds deterministic previews and diagnostics for the new visual states.
